title: The Gut Microbiota-Tryptophan-Kynurenine Metabolic Axis: A Novel Perspective on Remodeling the Immune Microenvironment of Pancreatic Cancer

contributions.purpose: 提出"微生物-色氨酸-免疫"三轴概念模型解释 PDAC 免疫逃逸
contributions.mechanism: 整合多组学文献,把肠道菌群作为外部调节者纳入 Trp-Kyn-AhR 免疫抑制网络,刻画空间异质性
contributions.evaluation: 定性综述模型(非原创实验);综合文献称 Treg 频率增 3.2 倍、Teff 代谢活性降 42%
contributions.domain: 胰腺癌免疫代谢 / 肠道菌群
contributions.source_quote: By integrating multi-omics analyses, we propose a novel "microbiota-Trp-immunity" tri-axial model, which delineates how microbial metabolites orchestrate spatial heterogeneity in the TME.

contributions.purpose: 机制性论证菌群如何竞争性重塑 Trp-Kyn 轴并放大免疫抑制
contributions.mechanism: 综述菌群酶活(色氨酸酶产 IPA、IAA 稳定 IDO1)、SLC7A5 介导的"Kyn 成瘾"、次级胆汁酸(DCA)与 Kyn 协同
contributions.evaluation: 定性(引文数据):循环 Trp 降至健康 1/32、DCA 使 Kyn 增 5 倍、OXPHOS 降 42%/乳酸增 2.3 倍
contributions.source_quote: Enterobacteriaceae (e.g., Enterobacter spp.) gain a competitive advantage in Trp uptake... reducing host circulating Trp levels to just 1/32 of those in healthy controls.

contributions.purpose: 提出基于菌群分层的精准联合干预框架
contributions.mechanism: "FMT + IDO1 抑制剂 + PD-1 抗体"三联、工程化色氨酸酶菌、纳米载体穿透纤维基质等时空特异性方案
contributions.evaluation: 提议性(未经作者原创验证);引文称工程菌降瘤内 Kyn 68%、FMT 降 Foxp3 处 H3K27me3 41%
contributions.source_quote: Precision combination therapy: "FMT + IDO1 inhibitor + PD-1 antibody" triplet regimens improve responses in PDX models by reprogramming Treg metabolism and restoring DC antigen presentation.

notes: 非实证类论文(医学综述/观点),无作者原创实验,四元组套用受限:evaluation 中的数字(Treg 3.2 倍、Teff/OXPHOS 降 42%、Trp 降 1/32、Kyn 增 5 倍、工程菌降 Kyn 68% 等)均为综合/引用文献所得而非作者自测数据,应作定性证据看待。无编号贡献列表,C1-C3 由 abstract+三条研究目标(L41-45)+Discussion 归纳。无严格负结果,但记录若干悖论/trade-off:IDO1 抑制剂在 PDAC 临床反复失败但机制无法解释(L135-136)、菌群干预动物有效难转化临床(L137-138)、FMT 供受体不相容致约 30% 病例不良事件(L245-246)、纤维基质使代谢物穿透率<20%/降 80-90%(L146,L242)。AI 披露(checklist 重点):实验设计=D(AI 生成),自承"Almost all the content of the paper was generated by AI, including tables and pictures";数据分析=C、写作=C;Code of Ethics=Yes 且明说"we used AI to write the paper";可复现性=No(基质胶批次、FMT 供者筛选标准、数据集划分未披露);理论证明=NA、开放代码=NA(自称 review paper)。Observed AI Limitations 中作者自承"AI may fabricate non-existent content, such as specific data or references, and even modify some highly recognized viewpoints, resulting in incorrect conclusions"——与正文多处引文错配吻合(如 ref[47] 天然珍珠母结晶相变论文被引作 Foxp3/H3K27me3 证据;ref[35] Barrett 食管内镜监测被引作 SLC7A5 证据),提示引用捏造/张冠李戴风险高。decision=reject。
